linkedin:
You can now use Nostr WoT without importing your Nostr private key into the extension.

We have developed Nostr Connect support using NIP-46. Connect your own remote signer, then use compatible Nostr websites through the extension's NIP-07 browser interface.

Your identity key stays with your signer. Nostr WoT forwards signing requests, and your signer handles approvals according to the permissions you choose.

Pair by scanning the extension's QR code or pasting a bunker connection link. Signing with Amber is working. You can also connect other remote signers with compatible NIP-46 support.

If you prefer to keep your key on another device, you can still use the extension as your connection to the Nostr web.

Nostr Connect is working in Nostr WoT.

Keep your Nostr private key in your own remote signer and use compatible Nostr websites through our extension. Nostr WoT connects the browser; your signer handles signing requests and permissions.

Pair with the QR code or a bunker link using NIP-46. Signing with Amber is working, and other remote signers with compatible NIP-46 support can connect too.

No need to import your Nostr identity key into the extension.
